tools.name: Canonical 12 File Archetypes & Taxonomy Sentinel
tools.purpose: Categorizes all 630 files in packages/core into the 12 Canonical Archetypes (Schema, Type, Port, Entity, Service, Adapter, Repository, Store, Slice, Hook, Flow, Barrel) to eliminate ambiguous Vibe Coder suffixes.

tools.name: Canonical 7-Tier Archetype & Invariant Sentinel
tools.purpose: Enforces the 7 Clean/Hexagonal Architectural Tiers (Schemas, Ports, Logic, Adapters, Stores, Hooks, UI). Detects Dependency Inversion violations (e.g. stores directly importing adapters) and schema runtime parsing in hooks.
tools.keyMetric: 7 Tiers, 11 Adapter Couplings, 2 Runtime Schemas in Hooks

tools.name: Code-ERD & Topological Layer Engine
tools.purpose: Discovers the full transitive dependency graph from any root component, extracts internal functions/types, and computes topological layers from bedrock leaves (out-degree 0).

tools.name: Bedrock Archaeology & Accretion Tracker
tools.purpose: Extracts git commit chronology (--follow) across all nodes to identify when Frankenstein ceremonies (like identityState.ts accretion) were introduced across 4 historical eras.

tools.name: Seam Clustering & Transitive Bypass Detector
tools.purpose: Clusters files into 7 architectural seams and detects diamond bypasses where upper layers (L12) reach around intermediate facades (L6/L11) to import lower-layer internals (L2/L0).

tools.name: Folder Ontology & Dispersion Auditor
tools.purpose: Audits all 29 top-level folders in core to map hook dispersion (80 hooks), store dispersion (27 stores), utility overlap (lib vs utils vs shared), and framework leaks.
tools.keyMetric: 841 Core Files across 29 Folders (Spans up to 10 Layers)

tools.name: Semantic Overlap & Redundancy Scanner
tools.purpose: Scans 4,057 exported symbols to isolate functional duplicates answering identical domain questions (e.g. 6 guest checkers, 5 button components, 6 storage wrappers).

tools.name: Architectural Contamination & Modern React 19 Sentinel
tools.purpose: Monorepo-wide AST/regex sentinel detecting Java OOP anti-patterns (GoF static singletons, useless pass-through wrappers, deadweight factories) and legacy React 18 patterns (forwardRef, useFormState, defaultProps, Zustand unselected subscriptions). Equipped with false-positive firewalls for Effect-TS, dispatchers, and grandfathered legacy ratchets.
tools.command: pnpm run check:contamination (delta) | pnpm run audit:contamination (full)
tools.keyMetric: 3,219 Files Scanned: 45 Java OOP Violations, 22 React 18 Violations (6 False Positives Protected)
